step_capped.rule: extra == step_cap - recorded_halt_step by construction: this reads as steps left on the clock, not turns bought by miss-plus-out

q2_miss_plus_out_replay.q2_basis_note: recorded = the miss-plus-out counter itself crossed and the dump shows its halt step; extrapolated = it never crossed, so the halt step is projected from the trailing increment. An extrapolated halt step is a projection, not a measurement, and q2_mpo_halt_step_near_boundary says how many sit just past the step cap.

q3_convergence.classification_rule: mutating = a write/edit/multi_edit tool (kind 'tool'), else an exec whose argv[0] is a write verb or whose program writes inline via open(...,'w'/'a') (kind 'exec_verb'); the strongest kind wins and q3_last3_mutation_evidence is that hit. Verbs are matched at command position only ('apt-get install' and 'chmod --help' are not writes). There is no shell-redirect kind: exec splits argv without a shell and rejects the operators, so '>' is a literal argument and cannot mutate the tree. A result with is_error true did not mutate and is skipped; a result with no recorded is_error is unknown, so the row counts in unknown_result and is never assumed read-only.

aggregates.scope_note: aggregates cover token-terminated, non-void rows only; the void families (pilot-dphn-cap and any run dir named void/) are reported in their own keys, because README.md marks the 18-run envelope chart 'Void, re-measured pending' (agent seeded from the Docker build context, not the image's /app).
